system.description:
Flurry Technique

Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage], you can spend 3 Discipline to force the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they suffer one of the following effects for the next minute of your choice:

Its speed is halved and cannot take Reactions if it would be taken against a Bukijutsu.

Its Armor Class is reduced by 2.

On its turn, it cannot take bonus actions.

The creature can remake its wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success. A creature who has ended this effect on themselves become immune to this Kata until you complete a Long Rest.

activities.label: Disorienting Strike
activities.text: Pick one of the three effects for 1 minute.
